relative_direction: Use the character's own left or right for gaze and turns, rather than screen/camera left or right.

duplicate_voice: {tag} appears twice. Bind it once in Reference identities.
pose_conflict: Recorded start pose and facing direction differ. Confirm the intended turn before generating.
